title: Color with Tidbit and Sugarfoot
subtitle: A big coloring book of friends, for ages 3 to 7
back_cover: Thirty-two big, simple pictures for little hands: Tidbit and Sugarfoot, Professor Puddles, Ollie the owl, Dot the snail, Hopper the frog, Nutmeg, Lumi, Beep, the ducklings, the Moon, the four clouds of Static, and more.
Every picture is on its own page, with a blank page behind it so markers will not soak through. Lines are thick and clear, with plenty of room for crayons.
A good companion to the read-aloud story Tidbit and Sugarfoot's Big Picnic.
